== Notes ==
* This skill removes a hex, removes a condition, and then heals. 
* [[Hero]]es use this skill properly, using it to cleanse themselves whether the target or themselves are afflicted.
** AI will just use this spell on allies for its healing aspect.
*The self healing and condition removal can help with skills with [[health sacrifice]] or [[Condition#Skills_which_inflict_conditions_on_oneself|that inflict conditions on oneself]].

== Trivia ==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.

{{anomaly|Unlike other healing skills, this spell can target [[spirit|spirits]] to remove [[burning]]. However, Empathic Removal will not heal the spirits.}}
